title: ANDESSENCE
subtitle: Commercial Marketing Website
summary: Commercial Marketing website focused on branding, SEO, and responsive design.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Mamatoya is a commercial website developed for a restaurant brand, focusing on presenting the business through a clean, responsive, and visually engaging online experience.

The project emphasizes translating business requirements into a production-ready website that supports brand identity, improves online visibility, and provides an intuitive browsing experience across devices.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
items: Gather business requirements and translate them into a structured website.
Design and implement responsive frontend pages using Vue.
Build reusable page sections for menus, branding, and business information.
Optimize page structure, images, and metadata for performance and search visibility.
Deploy and maintain the production website through Firebase Hosting.
Support future content updates while preserving a consistent visual experience.

technical_highlights.title: Technical Highlights
paragraphs: The project focuses on delivering a production-ready commercial website with responsive layouts, maintainable content organization, and foundational SEO, while keeping deployment and future updates straightforward.

items.title: Translating business requirements
items.description: Understanding business goals and converting them into a website that accurately represents the brand while remaining practical to develop and maintain.

items.title: Balancing branding and usability
items.description: Creating a visually engaging experience without sacrificing readability, accessibility, or responsive behavior across different devices.

items.title: Delivering within commercial constraints
items.description: Balancing design expectations, development effort, project budget, and future maintainability while delivering a production-ready website.

outcome.title: Outcome
paragraphs: The project resulted in a production-ready commercial website that strengthens the client's online presence while providing a maintainable foundation for future updates.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons Learned
items: Understanding business goals is just as important as implementing technical solutions.
Good commercial websites balance visual design, usability, and long-term maintainability.
Clear communication with clients leads to better technical decisions and smoother project delivery.
